reviewNotes: Sources were downloaded from HANS on 2026-11-19 into gitignored evidence/hans-20261119 only.
Equipment registrations, monster equipment-drop table, stage wave/boss pools, and card registrations are independently sourced from HANS.

HANS main killEnemy uses the soul kW monster-to-card index for normal and boss pickups, except in story mode or before a linked boss group is defeated. Stage script intruder entries supply the four extra boss routes. The current November 20 main killEnemy and xe definitions and soul kW, yW and UA definitions match the audited snapshot. Per-card draw pools are server-provided and are not inferred.
Item names and descriptions originate from the current HANS manifest; no old Coffee catalog content is merged.

Stage images are referenced only from each audited stage yW map ID and the audited manifest map.json directory. On November 20, all 17 HANS minimap.png URLs returned HTTP 200 and image/png; only source-hosted URLs/metadata are published, not the images.
Original bundled game code and full-resolution art must not be committed or deployed.

November 20 lap and card GS expansion reads the audited main RO_LAPC, RO_C2T, Bk, CC, TC, and soul Mp/vu/RO_J3 and Me registrations. The importer stores base card effects, variant rules, per-job scoring profiles, and derived stage tier/GS requirements. The main card floor rules (mini 20, MVP 30) and Osiris exception are matched against this SHA-pinned bundle, not inferred from classic RO card descriptions. Job-specific card GS still requires live in-game validation.

November 21 skill encyclopedia reads the same SHA-verified soul game bundle for $e and Ce skill registration metadata, official aA/KI translation dictionaries, and L(en, zh) third-job descriptions. It joins against SHA-audited public talents job/skill references; source bundles and icons are never copied into Pages. Unavailable skill description formulas and non-translated titles must not be fabricated.

November 21 third-job translation audit confirmed that all 96 registered third-job names have HANS native Traditional Chinese mapping via an appended top-level Object.assign(aA, {...}) after the initial aA declaration, not within the initial dictionary. The skills importer now statically merges these SHA-pinned translation blocks. All 96 Chinese titles are checked in tests and the public-build verifier while preserving original English search names.

2026-11-22 evening: re-audited the catalog sources. 17 expedition stages, 523 equipment entries and existing card/stage associations matched. RO_LAPC.raid registers 15 raid variants; 14 are new card registrations with no ordinary stage associations. Raid launch and server-side rewards remain separate from catalog registration. Skills and talents retain independent source baselines.
